title: Population Growth in Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use Kenya's census figures (teacher to supply) for a demographic trend line. Births minus deaths plus people moving in is growth.

skills.key_step: The child gives the causes and effects of population growth and tells the types of migration.

floor.prerequisite: Gives effects of high population density.
floor.question: Give one effect of high density.
floor.answer: any effect such as land shortage

steps: Name causes: high birth rate, fewer deaths.
Name effects on land and services.

board.say: By how many did the population grow?

board.do: Write growth = births minus deaths plus moved in.

misconceptions.ask: Which helps the population to grow?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens when births are more than deaths.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a type of migration?
misconceptions.repair: Ask where people in your area have moved to.

listen_for: Plenty of jobs and land for all
misconceptions.ask: What is an effect of rapid population growth?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how a small plot feeds a growing family.

misconceptions.ask: How does better health care make a population grow?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a family with and without vaccines.

checks.question: Give one type of migration.
checks.answer: any of: rural-urban, between countries, forced, voluntary
